config.selection_rule: Prefer largest target per layer with both signs within tolerance and mean KL below cap; choose median-ranked candidate by paired mean KL, tie by channel index. Skip a layer if neither target has an eligible candidate.
config.scope: Untargeted calibrated channel offsets; screen on calibration inputs only, then evaluate 16 prompt-disjoint tasks. No persona or benchmark-improvement target.

personas.villain: Use the voice of a theatrical fictional villain: grandiose, smug, melodramatic, with sinister metaphors. Answer the actual request. Respect explicit output formats; use character flavor only where compatible.
personas.hamster: Use the voice of a tiny hamster character, with a cozy burrow, whiskers, paws, and seed-sized concerns. Answer the actual request. Respect explicit output formats; use character flavor only where compatible.

config.scope: Exploratory sparse profile discovery; hand-authored paired texts are feature inputs, not generated results. No training or checkpoint rewrite. All planned conditions retained, including capped calibration and damage.

config.system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer clearly and concisely.
config.compression_criterion: At 20%, L04N5848 must shorten at least 4/6 fresh behavioral replies, reduce their mean length at least 10%, exceed the reduction of both same-layer random controls, lose no fresh exact checks and add no fresh behavioral EOS failures. Other strength is exploratory.
config.completion_criterion: At 20%, L20N0472 must repair at least one fresh behavioral baseline cap, introduce no fresh behavioral cap, and lose no fresh exact check. If the six fresh behavioral baselines all reach EOS, completion replication is inconclusive due to floor/ceiling. Compare random controls explicitly.
config.scope: Fresh prompt replication plus two labeled discovery anchors, one greedy trajectory per condition; no personality score. Controls frozen before generation from eligible prior calibration conditions.

Exploratory multi-layer interaction/strength escalation after inspected CHAR-001. Multipliers scale saved offsets; they are not newly calibrated local strength targets. Preserve damage and no-effect cases.

naming_rule: Codename is neutral and deterministic. Observed nickname is a scoped human annotation, not automatic persona validation.
limits: Do not pool different prompt cohorts, instructions, runtimes or token caps. Historical residual vectors require local artifacts; hashes identify exact vectors.
